fish.name: Rivet Gudgeon
fish.flavor: Its scales overlap in neat, regulation rows, as if it were assembled to spec. Inspectors have yet to find anything to fail it on.

fish.name: Grease Wisp
fish.flavor: Barely a fish; mostly a suggestion with fins. It slips through the water the way a rumor slips through a break room.

fish.name: Bolt-Eye Blenny
fish.flavor: It stares with the flat certainty of a machine that knows it is torqued correctly. Blinks exactly once per shift.

fish.name: Ladder Loach
fish.flavor: Climbs the rig's submerged ladders rung by rung, for reasons no one has been able to prove. Perhaps it's simply on its way up in the world.

fish.name: Foghorn Fry
fish.flavor: Puffs itself up and emits a tiny, mournful honk when the mist rolls in. Sailors find this adorable, which annoys it deeply.

fish.name: Tinker Smelt
fish.flavor: It collects lost washers and lock nuts to line its nest. Its life savings jingle when it swims.

fish.name: Barnacle Pilgrim
fish.flavor: It glued itself to the rig years ago, then had second thoughts. Now it wanders very slowly, carrying its old house on its back.

fish.name: Rustflake Dace
fish.flavor: Perfectly camouflaged against corroding steel, right down to the flaking. Reeling one in feels like peeling old paint, but friendlier.

fish.name: Pipe Whistler
fish.flavor: Lives in the outflow pipes and whistles when the current runs just right. The night crew swears it knows three songs and is learning a fourth.

fish.name: Drizzle Herring
fish.flavor: Only bites when it rains, and it always seems to know when it's about to. Old riggers plan their laundry around it.

fish.name: Weldlight Sardine
fish.flavor: Its flanks spark faintly, like a torch seen through fog. A school of them looks like a night shift that never clocks out.

fish.name: Gantry Goby
fish.flavor: It perches on the submerged crossbeams and supervises the divers, offering no help whatsoever. Management material.

fish.name: Clockwork Chub
fish.flavor: It ticks. Nobody has opened one up to find out why, mostly out of politeness.

fish.name: Coglight Eel
fish.flavor: Light turns in slow, meshing rings beneath its skin, like gears made of moonlight. It is mesmerizing, and slightly smug about it.

fish.name: Murmur Mackerel
fish.flavor: It swims in schools that whisper. Press your ear to the hull at night and you can almost make out the gossip.

fish.name: Gasket Ghost
fish.flavor: Thin, pale, and precisely the shape of the seal that went missing from pump station four. The pump still works. Nobody asks how.

fish.name: Static Skipper
fish.flavor: Years of nosing around electrical conduits have left its scales with a faint standing charge. Petting one is a memorable, one-time decision.

fish.name: Teakettle Puffer
fish.flavor: When alarmed, it swells up and emits a thin, rising whistle. It goes off at four o'clock sharp every day, and the crew takes their tea accordingly.

fish.name: Saint Elmo's Sprat
fish.flavor: It wears a soft halo of blue fire that never burns anything. Old sailors tip their hats to it, and it clearly expects them to.

fish.name: Windlass Wrasse
fish.flavor: It feeds in tight, patient circles, winding an invisible rope. Divers who watch too long report a strong urge to be hoisted.

fish.name: Penny-Eyed Prophet
fish.flavor: Its eyes are the exact dull copper of an old coin, and they see next Tuesday clearly. It won't tell you what happens, but it does look sorry.

fish.name: Marrowlight Conger
fish.flavor: It glows from the inside out, as if lit by its own bones. Down in the rig's shadow it drifts like a lantern nobody is carrying.

fish.name: Oilslick Siren
fish.flavor: Its scales shimmer with every color oil knows how to lie about. Its song sounds like machinery remembering that it used to be a forest.

fish.name: Derrick Dreamer
fish.flavor: It sleeps coiled around the deepest pylon, and the whole rig sways gently in time with its breathing. Please do not wake it before the coffee's ready.

fish.name: Hymnal Hagfish
fish.flavor: On quiet mornings it hums something very old through the hull plating. The crew stopped checking what makes the sound; some things you simply attend.

fish.name: The Night Shift
fish.flavor: It clocks in at dusk and patrols the pylons until dawn, punctual to the minute, every night, for decades. No one hired it, and no one is brave enough to terminate the contract.

fish.name: Machinist's Halo
fish.flavor: A perfect ring of pale gold light with, presumably, a fish somewhere inside it. Catching one feels like being briefly forgiven for everything.

fish.name: The Bell Below
fish.flavor: Somewhere under the rig, a bell nobody installed rings once a year. This fish arrives the morning after, dressed for the occasion, and waits to be congratulated.

fish.name: The Rustmother
fish.flavor: They say every flake of rust on the rig is a scale she shed on her way through, and that the structure is less abandoned than adopted. At night the derrick groans, and something vast and patient answers from below.

fish.name: The Perpetual Motion
fish.flavor: A hand-span of silver that has been swimming since before the first engine turned, and will still be swimming after the last one cools. Hold it for one impossible moment, feel everything around you hum, and then let it go — it has somewhere to be.
